name: ESA WorldCereal Global Maps: 10m Crop Type and Irrigation Products
description: ESA WorldCereal Global Maps is the first open-access, dynamically updated 10-meter global agricultural monitoring product suite funded by the European Space Agency (ESA) and developed by an international consortium led by VITO Remote Sensing. Utilizing Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and Landsat 8 satellite time-series, WorldCereal delivers global raster layers detailing temporary cropland extent, season-specific active cropland, crop types (maize, winter cereals, spring cereals), and active irrigation status across worldwide agro-ecological zones.
